full_prompt_en: A square romantic oil painting captures a group of riders charging across uneven grassland beneath a heavy gray sky. In the center foreground, two pale horses surge toward the right, their forelegs stretched forward and rear legs kicking up dust from the rough ground. The riders lean with the movement, dressed in loose light garments and dark or red head coverings. One central rider raises a thin staff or long weapon diagonally toward the upper right. At the left, more mounted figures press into the scene, partly cropped by the frame, while a dark horse and rider form a strong counterweight on the right. Additional smaller figures scatter across the middle distance, growing softer and darker against the low line of distant hills. The foreground is mottled olive, brown, and gray, marked by torn grass, bare patches, and a plume of pale dust behind the nearest hooves. Above, blue gray clouds gather in layered, irregular masses, with a thin lighter opening near the horizon. The sky occupies a broad upper band and makes the group below feel exposed to changing weather. Brushwork is energetic and broken along the running legs, fabrics, and dust, but the nearest faces and horse heads receive enough controlled detail to stay legible. Diffuse overcast light catches the white coats and garments, leaving brown bodies and distant riders in softer shadow. The overall composition drives diagonally from left background to right foreground, using repeated movement and turbulent paint to give the riders urgent momentum.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形浪漫主义油画捕捉一队骑手在沉重灰天下穿过起伏草地疾驰。中央前景，两匹浅色马朝右冲出，前腿前伸，后腿从粗糙地面踢起尘土。骑手顺着动作前倾，穿宽松浅色衣服，戴深色或红色头巾。一名中央骑手将细长的杖或兵器朝右上斜举。左侧，更多骑马人物挤入画面，部分被画边裁掉；右侧一匹深色马与骑手形成有力平衡。另有较小人物散在中景，在远处低矮山丘前逐渐柔和、变暗。前景由橄榄、棕和灰色斑驳构成，带有撕碎般的草、裸地和最近马蹄后方一团浅色灰尘。上方，蓝灰云以不规则层次聚集，地平线附近开着一条较亮的窄缝。天空占据宽阔上带，让下方人群显得暴露在变动天气中。奔跑的腿、衣料和灰尘处笔触活跃而断续，最近的面孔与马头仍获得足够受控的细节，保持可辨。阴天漫射光照到白色皮毛与衣服，棕色身体和远处骑手留在更柔和的阴影里。整体构图从左侧背景斜向冲往右侧前景，借重复运动和翻涌的颜料让骑手有迫切动势。
style_prompt_en: Romantic oil painting uses broken vigorous strokes to carry motion across a wide, earthy composition. Olive, umber, dusty brown, blue gray, and small chalky white passages form a subdued palette with the brightest notes concentrated near the action. Repeated diagonals and overlapping rounded masses drive the eye from a dense rear group toward a clearer foreground cluster. Edges are selective: key outer contours briefly sharpen, then dissolve into dust like scumbles and loose marks. A broad turbulent cool upper field presses down on the warmer lower field, creating drama through atmospheric weight rather than saturated color. Diffuse light lifts pale surfaces without strong directional shadow, while darker forms retain subtle reflected gray. Paint texture remains conspicuous in ground and atmosphere, with finer modeling only where recognition matters most. The overall effect is urgent and windswept, balancing legible forms against the looseness of movement.
style_prompt_zh: 浪漫主义油画以断续有力的笔触承载宽阔土色构图中的运动。橄榄色、棕褐、灰尘般的棕色、蓝灰与少量粉白组成低饱和色域，最亮的笔迹集中在活动处。重复斜线和重叠圆润体块推动视线从密集后部走向更清楚的前景聚合。边缘有选择地出现：关键外轮廓短暂变锐，随后溶入灰尘般的干擦和松笔。宽阔、翻涌的冷色上方区域压向较暖下方区域，通过空气重量而非饱和色彩形成戏剧性。漫射光提亮浅色表面，没有强烈定向阴影，较暗形状仍保留细微反射灰调。地面和空气中的颜料肌理清楚可见，只有最需要辨认的地方塑形更细。整体效果紧迫而有风感，在可读形体与运动的松散之间平衡。
theme_en: A group of riders charging across rough grass under storm clouds
theme_zh: 一队骑手在风暴云下穿过粗草地疾驰
name: Adolf Schreyer
